P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: The garden features a defined pool edge, brick retaining walls, and dense surrounding foliage that creates a sense of enclosure, resembling an outdoor room.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Tall dracaena and background trees form upper layers; mid-height shrubs and potted plants fill the middle; ground-level foliage and poolside planting complete the base. Lush, multi-layered composition.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The large, centrally positioned succulent plant dominates the frame and acts as the clear focal point, with the pool and surrounding greenery arranged around it.
